title: The Cat Who Chose Us
sentences: A grey cat came into our garden last spring.
She was thin and her fur was dirty.
We gave her some food and she came back the next day.
After two weeks she started sleeping on our step.
We asked the neighbours, but nobody knew her.
So we opened the door and let her come inside.
Now she sleeps on the chair near the window.
She wakes me up at six every morning.
My son gave her the name Smoke.
We did not choose a cat, but we have one now.
